summary.text: Michael Mason is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 79 in the November 3, 2026 general election; no other candidate is listed for the seat.
He served on the Little Rock School District board, representing Zone 1, from December 2020 to March 2026.

paragraphs.text: Michael Mason earned a high school diploma from Little Rock Central High, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff in 1981 and a graduate degree from Webster University in 1991.
His career experience includes working in government administration.
Mason was elected to the Little Rock School District board, Zone 1, in 2020, when the general election was canceled and he won without appearing on the ballot; he assumed office on December 17, 2020.
He left the board on March 19, 2026, and did not run for re-election in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Mason said he has worked as a public servant for more than 40 years and for over 20 years has helped Arkansans resolve housing needs and landlord-tenant complaints.
He listed warranty of habitability, public education, affordable child care, a healthy Arkansas and women's rights as policy areas he is passionate about.
